tjalda.title: Tjalda.is – Hlíð, Mývatni listing (2026 rates, season & services)

ferdalag-winter.title: Ferdalag.is (Icelandic Tourist Board) – Camper winter service

intro.value: A large, unmarked campsite on the edge of a lava field by the village of Reykjahlíð on the north shore of Lake Mývatn: you pick your own spot on grass or in sheltered lava hollows. It is about 1 km from the lake shore, and the operator says that, with little tree cover, there are far fewer midges than elsewhere around Mývatn. The tourist information centre and supermarket are about a 5-minute walk away.

address.note: tjalda.is gives postcode 610 and ferdalag.is 660 (Hraunbrún, 660 Mývatn).

winter.value: Open all year according to tjalda.is, and listed on ferdalag.is's official camper winter service list. The reception is closed in winter; information is on a notice on the reception door and on the website. Which facilities (shower building, kitchen tent, electricity) are available in winter is not stated: Unconfirmed, so call ahead.

items.label: Children under 15 with a parent or guardian
Lodging tax per unit per night

electricity.value: Yes – sockets across the site, 900 ISK per night. Number of hook-ups and winter availability: Unconfirmed.

kitchen.value: A large kitchen tent with gas stoves, open to all campers, plus dish-washing facilities. Not an indoor kitchen; whether it is up in winter is Unconfirmed.

showers.value: Yes – a shower building; hot showers included in the price

toilets.value: Two toilet buildings; several washing points with hot and cold water

dump_station.note: No chemical-toilet or grey-water disposal is mentioned on the own site, tjalda.is or ferdalag.is.

camping_card.note: Not stated in the sources checked.

practical.value: No booking needed: the operator says there is always space.
Reception hours on the own site are 8–10 and 17–22, but the reception is closed in winter.
A small shop in the reception building sells snacks, soft drinks, dairy products and postcards; bike rental is offered.
